climate.overview_html: The BAMS State of the Climate 2025 report confirms record greenhouse gases, sea level, and ocean heat in 2025. The Balkans heatwave, which drove over 28,000 EU excess deaths, has fully dissipated as of August 19.

items.headline: Extraordinary August 2026 ENSO Diagnostic: Subsurface Pacific Heat Reaches +10°C
items.summary: 69% probability the 2026/27 El Niño exceeds every event since 1950.

items.headline: August 2026 Tracking as Third-Warmest August on Record Globally
items.summary: SW Europe posts its most intense August heat anomaly in the ERA5 record back to 1940.

items.headline: Balkans Heatwave Fully Ends — All Heat Alerts Lifted
items.summary: Episode attributed to over 28,000 EU excess deaths since June — deadliest since 2003.

science.overview_html: A new Nature Climate Change paper finds AMOC stability depends on the rate of warming, not just its level — collapsing at +2°C under fast forcing.

items.headline: State of the Climate in 2025: Record Greenhouse Gases, Sea Level, Ocean Heat
items.summary: 2025 ranks among the three warmest years since 1850 despite La Niña.

items.headline: Rate of Warming, Not Just Temperature Level, Determines AMOC Collapse Risk
items.summary: Slow CO2 ramps keep AMOC stable to +5.5°C; fast ramps collapse it at +2°C.

items.headline: ECMWF Discontinues Daily Runs of External AI Weather Models
items.summary: Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, Aurora, FourCastNet phased out as in-house AIFS matures.

items.title: Form Energy Raises $750M Series G to Scale Iron-Air Battery Manufacturing
items.body_html: Form Energy, maker of 100-hour iron-air batteries, closed a $750M Series G led by T. Rowe Price, with Sequoia and Franklin Templeton joining. The round brings total equity raised past $2 billion. Commercial backlog quadrupled this year to 80 GWh, including contracts with Xcel Energy and Google.
